summary: Senior Credit Investments, LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a cash distribution of $16.7099 per unit declared on June 29, 2026, payable on July 20, 2026, to holders of record as of the declaration date. The distribution is a routine capital return to unitholders and does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, strategic review, or other special situation. The filing is a standard periodic distribution announcement for a business development company or closed-end fund. No deal terms, advisor involvement, or regulatory milestones are present. This is purely a distribution event with no special-situation characteristics.
